case_number: Crl. Appeal No. 1566-J of 2019 / Crl. Appeal No. 1567-J of 2019 / Crl. Revision No. 469 of 2019

trial_court.court_name: Additional Sessions Judge, Rajanpur Model Criminal Trial Court

facts.summary: FIR No.298/2019 registered at Fazilpur, Rajanpur. Conviction: 302(b)/34 PPC, Sentence: Imprisonment for life

legal_issues.finding: Unexplained delay of two hours and ten minutes in lodging FIR despite short distance created doubt.
legal_issues.principle: Unexplained delay indicates deliberation and consultation, rendering prosecution story doubtful.
relied_cases: Mehmood Ahmed & 3 others vs. The State & another (1995 SCMR 127)
Zafar Ali Abbasi and another vs. Zafar Ali Abbasi and others (2024 SCMR 1773)
Manzar Abbas and another vs. The State (2025 SCMR 1024)
Muhammad alias Ahmad vs. The State (2025 SCMR 2052)

legal_issues.finding: Eyewitnesses failed to justify presence and acted unnaturally.
legal_issues.principle: Testimony of chance witness not accepted without convincing explanation.
relied_cases: Mst Shazia Parveen vs. The State (2014 SCMR 1197)
Muhammad Rafique vs. The State (2014 SCMR 1698)
Naveed Asghar and 2 others vs. The State (PLD 2021 SC 600)
Abdul Khaliq vs. The State (2021 SCMR 325)
Muhammad Hassan and another vs. The State and others (2024 SCMR 1427)
Imran vs. The State (2026 SCMR 47)
Abdul Hayee and Abdullah alias Ghazali and another Versus The State and others (2025 SCMR 281)

legal_issues.finding: Witnesses improved statements by attributing new roles to accused.
legal_issues.principle: Dishonest improvements cast serious doubt and render testimony unreliable.
relied_cases: Mst. Saima Noreen and another Vs. The State (2024 SCMR 1310)
Fateh Khan vs. The State and others (2025 SCMR 1408)
Muhammad Nasir Butt and 2 others vs. The State and others (2025 SCMR 662)

legal_issues.finding: Identification parade unreliable due to prior exposure and conflicting roles.
legal_issues.principle: Test identification loses value if irregularities or prior exposure exist.
relied_cases: Abdul Qadeer vs. The State (2024 SCMR 1146)
Tahseen Ullah and another vs. The State (2025 SCMR 2018)

legal_issues.finding: Failure to produce blood-stained clothes weakened prosecution case.
legal_issues.principle: Non-production prevents corroboration and undermines veracity.
relied_cases: Mst. Sughra Begum and another vs. Qaiser Pervez and others (2015 SCMR 1142)
Mst. Mir Zalai vs. Ghazi Khan and others (2020 SCMR 319)

legal_issues.finding: Medical evidence only corroborative; cannot sustain conviction without reliable ocular account.
legal_issues.principle: Medical evidence confirms injuries but cannot identify accused.
relied_cases: Munawar Ali alias Munawar Hussain vs. The State (PLD 1993 SC 251)
Muhammad Jahangir and another Vs. The State and others (2024 SCMR 1741)

legal_issues.finding: Recovery discarded due to absence of independent witnesses.
legal_issues.principle: Violation of Section 103 Cr.P.C. renders recovery unreliable.
relied_cases: Muhammad Ismail and others vs. The State (2017 SCMR 713)
Gul Dast Khan vs. The State (2009 SCMR 431)
Muhammad Hussain vs. The State (2011 SCMR 1127)

legal_issues.finding: Multiple doubts in prosecution case entitled appellants to acquittal.
legal_issues.principle: Single reasonable doubt sufficient for acquittal.
relied_cases: Muhammad Riaz vs. Khurram Shehzad and another (2024 SCMR 51)
Muhammad Nawaz and another vs. The State and others (2024 SCMR 1731)

judgment_summary.final_order: Conviction and sentence set aside; appellants acquitted
